item.title: NHL roundup: Olivier's two goals and Merzlikins' shutout power Blue Jackets to sixth straight win
item.description: NEWARK, N.J. (AP) — Mathieu Olivier scored twice in the third period, and Elvis Merzlikins made 23 saves for his first shutout of the season as the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the New Jersey Devils 3-0 on Tuesday night for their sixth straight win.
